---
title: "Bad document options"
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  max-zom: 8
  zzz: 1
  fit: sideways
  hint: maybe
  loop: "true"
  caption: on
  match: all
  max-zoom: lots
  css-class: [a, b]
  backdrop: "red; } body {"
expect-errors:
  - 'Field "backdrop" has value red; } body {, which must instead be a CSS colour'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:backdrop.'
  - 'Field "caption" has value on, which must instead be `true` or `false`'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:caption.'
  - 'ℹ Quarto uses YAML 1.2, which interprets booleans strictly.'
  - 'ℹ Try using true instead.'
  - 'Field "css-class" has value [a, b], which must instead be a string'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:css-class.'
  - 'Field "fit" has value sideways, which must instead be one of: `auto`, `contain`, `height`, `width`'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:fit.'
  - 'Field "hint" has value maybe, which must instead be `true` or `false`'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:hint.'
  - 'Field "loop" has value "true", which must instead be `true` or `false`'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:loop.'
  - 'ℹ Quarto uses YAML 1.2, which interprets booleans strictly.'
  - 'ℹ Try using true instead.'
  - 'Field "match" has value all, which must instead be ''auto'''
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:match.'
  - 'property name max-zom is invalid'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:max-zom.'
  - 'ℹ Did you mean max-zoom?'
  - 'Field "max-zoom" has value lots, which must instead be a number greater than 0'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:max-zoom.'
  - 'property name zzz is invalid'
  - 'ℹ The error happened in location panzoom:zzz.'
---

Mistakes in the document's `panzoom:` options, each reported once.
